pyr: Run ./run.py with Python and forward arguments.
pym: Run ./main.py with Python and forward arguments.
pyv: Create a virtual environment, defaulting to .venv.
activate: Activate a virtual environment, defaulting to .venv.
mkcd: Create a directory and enter it.
take: Create nested directories and enter the final directory.
croot: Jump to the Git repository root.
pyreq: Write the current Python environment to requirements.txt.
tx explore: Open the experimental visual directory navigator.
tx pulse: Run a command with a terminal-output-reactive activity display.
